plain.li: {GOD} keep us.
By {GOD}, what a day this has been.
I said a word to {GOD} this morning, just in case.
If {GOD} is listening, a little help would be welcome.
{GOD} sees all of this, you know.
[storm] {GOD} must be angry with someone tonight.
[storm] Pray {GOD} keeps the lightning off the roof.
[storm,god:storm] Easy now, {GOD}, we heard you the first time.
[storm,god:storm] That's {GOD} out walking, so keep your heads down.
[cold] {GOD} send us a kinder wind than this.
[cold] I asked {GOD} for a mild winter, and here we are.
[heat] {GOD}, a little rain would not go amiss.
[heat,god:harvest] Spare the fields, {GOD}, and you can have the rest of us.
[snow] First snow, so {GOD} has turned the year again.
[snow,child] Did {GOD} send the snow just for us?
[hurt] {GOD} mend me, and quickly.
[hurt,god:healing] {GOD} will have me up again in no time.
[grieving] {GOD} keep them now, since we couldn't.
[grieving,god:dead] Walk them gently home, {GOD}.
[lowmood] {GOD}, give me the strength for one more day.
[lowmood] I don't know if {GOD} hears me, but I keep asking.
[highmood] Thank {GOD} for a day like this.
[highmood] Someone up there likes us, and I'd say it's {GOD}.
[fall,god:harvest] {GOD} was good to us this year.
[night,god:night] {GOD} is bright tonight.
[kind:archotech] {GOD} will have noted that, it notes everything.
[kind:archotech] Don't bother praying to {GOD}, it only counts what you do.
[kind:trickster] Don't thank {GOD} too loudly, it only encourages it.
[kind:hunger] Hush, don't say its name, it listens.
[kind:fading] Somebody has to remember {GOD}, so it may as well be me.
[kind:newborn] {GOD} is small yet, but it's ours.
[tribal] The spirits are watching, {GOD} most of all.
[spacer] Whatever {GOD} is, I hope it's on our side.
